note: The external tools this repository calls, pinned. Nothing here is vendored: bootstrap.py fetches each tool from its own source at the version named below, checks what can be checked, and installs it for the current user outside the repository. Decided by the person on 2026-11-05 (docs/ideas/20261105.md). A change of version is a commit to this file with its new checksums.

node.why: rea-agents 6.8.0 declares node ^22.23.4 || ^24.22.1 || >=26.12.1; the 24 line has prebuilt native modules for REA's dependencies.

rea.install_scripts: not run. frida's install script fetches a native module for runtime capture, which plan.md 5.1 S2 allows only under analysis_permission; enabling it is the person's step.
rea.mcp: stdio, through .mcp.json: python bootstrap.py run rea mcp

harness2.platform: Linux only (POSIX, Python 3.12). On Windows it is installed inside a WSL distribution by the same script run there.
harness2.use: a reference and, under plan.md 14-8, a trial engine: outside this repository, mock only, output = proposals. Model-backed runs need the person's own model account and are not set up here.
